lead: Changing what a request's params are breaks the extension silently.
body: `regions()` in `editors/vscode/src/regions.ts` wraps its `sendRequest` in a `try`/`catch` returning `[]`, so params the server refuses read as "this file has no markup" and the HTML services stop forwarding, with neither `cargo test` nor `npm run compile` seeing it. Grep `editors/vscode/src` for the `METHOD` constant of any request whose dispatch arm in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/server.rs` you retype, and land both sides together.
